DATETIME columns dispatch to 'Date|Number(int elements)': first element '2007-07-01 12:00:00.0' does NOT parse as int, so Date fuzzer is chosen (not Number).

All NOT NULL flags are 0 (notnull=0) even for PKs: upstream does not enforce NOT NULL; PK uniqueness enforced only by sample_fresh_primary_keys.
No CHECK constraints, no UNIQUE columns, no composite PKs, no self-FKs, no dangling FKs in this DB — simplest case for process_order (Demog level 0, Customers level 1, Mailings1_2/Sales level 2).
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on all INTEGER/REAL columns: scale=0 for INTEGER (range [-1,1] then perturb +-1/+-2), scale=4 for REAL (range [-10000,10000]); int-like strings in pool get +-1 variants.
Date fuzzer on REF_DATE/EVENT_DATE with template '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.0' (from first parsable element); p=0.2 means element returned 20% of time, fresh uniform datetime 80%.
String fuzzer on SEX/MARITAL_STATUS/OCCUPATION/RESPONSE: charset a-zA-Z 0-9() with contamination; will produce implausible values like 'Male' -> 'MaleXy3' or random garbage.
RESPONSE has only 'true'/'false' (2 distinct): String fuzzer will generate many other strings, breaking boolean-like semantics — likely FN source for queries filtering RESPONSE='true'.
SEX has only 'Male'/'Female': String fuzzer generates garbage; queries with SEX='Male' will match fewer rows than expected -> FN.
MARITAL_STATUS 5 distinct, OCCUPATION 9 distinct: String fuzzer generates implausible values; equality filters on these will under-match -> FN.

GEOID in Customers has 123 distinct but Demog has 200 rows: FK draw from Demog's final GEOID (200 values) with replacement; some Customers rows get GEOIDs not in original 123 -> plausible but changes join cardinality.

EDUCATIONNUM 17 distinct, age 69 distinct: Number fuzzer with scale=0 produces values in [-1,1] then perturbed to small ints like -2,-1,0,1,2,3 — implausible for age (real 17-90) -> FN on age range filters.
INCOME_K/INHABITANTS_K REAL with scale=4: range [-10000,10000] covers real values (2631, 30) but also negatives — implausible for income/inhabitants -> FN on positive filters.
A_VAR1..A_VAR18 REAL ~190 distinct each: Number fuzzer scale=4 produces wide range; queries comparing A_VARi to constants may match differently -> FP/FN.
AMOUNT REAL 10001 distinct (0.01 granularity): Number fuzzer scale=4 gives 4-decimal values, not 3-decimal like original -> slight mismatch on exact equality, fine on range.
PK columns (GEOID, REFID, ID, EVENTID) get max_l0=inf (single-column PK): fresh draws never reused, so PKs are unique-ish; sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicates -> table sizes shrink slightly.
